authorship_boundary: This system participated in producer-side premise work and Cert packet preparation. This Referee pass is a separate non-authoring logical pass and is not used as independence evidence.

questions.question: Are the four accepted statements proved at exactly their stated scopes?
questions.basis: The adversary pass found no counterexample or hidden scope extension. PREM-001 preserves selected bounded triangular faces while removing parallelism but preserves concurrence. PREM-002 through PREM-004 explicitly require pairwise nonparallelism; PREM-003 additionally requires even n>=4.

questions.question: Is the evidence route compatible with MATHCERT's sole-evidence prohibition?
questions.basis: The producer system is disclosed and is not presented as independent. PREM-001 binds independently published projective-geometry sources with exact source bytes; PREM-002 through PREM-004 bind a prior independently authored Kobon source and fresh exact-commit Lean replay for local fan components. WP07 and other zero-context returns are corroboration only and are not promoted to reserved independence.

questions.question: Does any finite computation or CI result substitute for mathematical proof?
questions.basis: Finite cyclic-mask/parity replay is corroborative only; producer fixtures are explicitly non-authoritative; CI is only an integration gate.

questions.question: Does the external Lean replay justify Level 4/5 status for any entire premise?
questions.basis: The Lean artifacts formalize local fan and conditional arithmetic components only. Global arrangement extraction and PREM-001/003/004 remain paper-level.

questions.question: Do these dispositions imply a downstream q-profile exclusion or hill-global upper bound?
questions.basis: The packet expressly excludes q=3/q=4/q=5/q=6 downstream theorem certification, K(18)<=94, optimality, novelty, competition acceptance, and publication readiness.

required_residuals: Protected exact-head CI and merge/readback remain required before certification effect exists.
Any downstream H1 reduction must receive its own exact-subject adjudication before losing NOT_CERTIFIED status.
